column1: # Play 6 G0058 chip volume table (apps/core/lumen-audio ChipTable). Stock V1.7.116 (Android 11) services.jar AudioService
# VolumeStreamState.setDspVolumesForHal (decompile outp6_as 4693-4745: no ";device=" on bluetooth_volume), the
# constructor's sets (527-528: fixed DGTL dock 0x1000, ANLG dock 0x800, AUX_LINE; full empty) and the
# libxgimiaudiopolicy threadInit path table (switch_start / switch_end strings in the V1.7.116 library).
out     6     xgimi_pcm_volume  -       -     # SPDIF 0x80000: a level, never a path
out     10    -                 -       2     # HDMI ARC: no chip key
path    0                                     # every other output: the speaker path
# The mt5889 HAL takes bluetooth_volume only while its sink is A2DP and keeps no level per sink ("doesn't set acap
# volume! current sink device is not a2dp device", device log 2026-10-24): every level goes again after switch_end.
